description: Offset pagination across as many as 101 independent PostgREST reads has no snapshot or concurrent-write contract. An insertion before the current offset can shift a previously read row into the next page, causing a duplicate and an omitted row; core deduplication removes the duplicate but cannot recover the omission. The matrix tests static page sequences only, so silently incomplete scoring remains possible without reaching the sentinel.

evidence.snippet: Each stream orders by occurred_at.asc,public_ref.asc and paginates with limit=1000 and explicit offsets until a short page.
